d:
Ravivar, 1 navanbar ko jahan ek or vipakshi indiya gathbandhan ne 'vot bachao, desh bachao maha raili' nikali hai. vahin 1984 ke sikh virodhi dangon ko lekar bijepi ne kangres ke khilaf pashchimi dilli men march nikala. yah march hari nagar sthit ditisi bas dipo se shuru hokar tilak nagar metro steshan tak nikala gaya. is march men sikh samuday ke logon ke sath bari sankhya men bijepi karyakarta bhi shamil hue. march men shamil hue logon ne kya kaha? dekhie bibisi sanvaddata shubh rana aur ariba ansari ki riport.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
